name: pumi-p-rex
description: P-Rex as a UI theme: the terminals' own colours, a little see-through; views as a list down the side, the panes as cards or edge to edge.

appearance.label: Mode
appearance.desc: Night or day when no terminal color scheme is picked (a picked scheme's look wins), or follow the system.

pane_style.label: Pane style
pane_style.desc: Each pane a rounded card with room round it, or panes edge to edge with a line between.

opacity.label: Background opacity
opacity.desc: How much of the desktop shows through the window: 100 is opaque.

pane_titles.label: Show pane title bars
pane_titles.desc: A strip over each pane with its tabs, its name and its buttons, to drag it by. Off, only a pane of several tabs keeps one.

pane_outline.label: Outline the focused pane
pane_outline.desc: A line round the pane with the focus while its view is split.

pane_equalize.label: Even out splits automatically
pane_equalize.desc: Every pane in a view gets an equal share as one opens or closes.

focus_follows_mouse.label: Focus the pane under the mouse
focus_follows_mouse.desc: A pane takes the focus as the mouse moves onto it, without a click.

sidebar_swipe.label: Hide the side bar with a swipe
sidebar_swipe.desc: Two fingers swept left over the side bar hide it; ⌘B brings it back.

view_icons.label: Tab icons per view
view_icons.desc: How many of a view's tabs show as icons beside its name; past that, a count.

animate.label: Animate layout changes
animate.desc: Panes glide into place as they open, close, move and zoom.

haptics.label: Haptic feedback
haptics.desc: A tap on a Force Touch trackpad as a switch turns or a slider steps. Nothing on a mouse.
